themes.title: First-hour workspace setup is slow and generic
themes.summary: New workspace setup takes ~40 minutes because templates don't match hybrid kanban/sprint team structures and the onboarding checklist doesn't adapt to team type, forcing custom setup from scratch every time.
supporting_quotes: it took me almost 40 minutes just to get the board set up the way I wanted
It felt like it was designed for a solo user, not an agency team like ours.

themes.title: Team invitation flow doesn't scale past one person at a time
themes.summary: There is no bulk invite option surfaced anywhere intuitive; the participant added six teammates one at a time and the actual bulk feature (if any) is buried under Workspace Admin.
supporting_quotes: I ended up adding six people one at a time.
it's buried under "Workspace Admin" which isn't intuitive at all

pain_points.description: No project template matches hybrid kanban/sprint team structures (e.g. agency teams), forcing manual column setup from scratch on every new workspace.
pain_points.quote: there's no template for that, so I had to build custom columns from scratch

pain_points.description: Bulk-invite functionality is either missing or hidden under Workspace Admin instead of the main invite screen.
pain_points.quote: I'd expect that on the main invite screen

pain_points.description: Onboarding checklist is generic and doesn't adapt based on the industry/team type selected at signup.
pain_points.quote: it doesn't actually adapt based on what industry or team type you picked during signup

action_items.action: Add pre-built workspace templates for common team structures (agency, engineering, marketing) with sensible default columns.
action_items.rationale: Directly requested fix; recurring pain the user hits twice a month at every project kickoff.

action_items.action: Add bulk invite via email list or CSV upload directly on the primary invite screen.
action_items.rationale: Current workaround (one-at-a-time invites) doesn't scale and the existing option is undiscoverable.

action_items.action: Make the post-signup onboarding checklist adapt based on team type/industry selected during signup.
action_items.rationale: Checklist currently feels built for solo users, mismatched with agency/team use cases.
